settings.title: Authentication Status
settings.desc: Affects how you join the Minecraft server.
settings.info-premium: Auto-login with your Microsoft account. No password needed.
settings.info-cracked: You'll need to enter a password when joining the server.
settings.info-auto: The server will detect your account type automatically.
settings.link-desc: Verify your Minecraft account ownership to preserve your data when switching to premium.

microsoft.login-error: Microsoft login failed. Please try again.
microsoft.account-not-linked: No Pano account is linked to this Minecraft account. Please register first.
microsoft.account-already-linked: A Pano account already exists with this Minecraft username.
microsoft.login-success: Signed in with Minecraft premium account: {username}

plugin-settings.title: Microsoft Login Settings
plugin-settings.setup-guide-title: How to set up Microsoft Login
plugin-settings.setup-step-2: Set a name for your app, select 'Personal Microsoft accounts only' as account type.
plugin-settings.setup-step-3: Under Redirect URI, select 'Web' and enter the Redirect URI shown below.
plugin-settings.setup-step-4: After registration, copy the Application (client) ID and paste it into the Client ID field.
plugin-settings.setup-step-5: Go to Certificates & Secrets → New client secret. Copy the secret value and paste it into the Client Secret field.
plugin-settings.verification-notice: Minecraft requires app verification to combat fraud and scams. Submit your app for verification at aka.ms/AppRegInfo to allow all users to use this feature.
plugin-settings.enabled-desc: Allow users to sign in and register using their Microsoft/Minecraft account.
plugin-settings.client-id-desc: Application (client) ID from Azure Portal → Overview.
plugin-settings.client-secret-desc: Secret value from Azure Portal → Certificates & Secrets.
plugin-settings.reveal-desc: Enter your password to view the client secret.
plugin-settings.redirect-uri-desc: Must match exactly with the URI registered in Azure AD.
plugin-settings.debug-logging-desc: Log detailed step-by-step information during Microsoft OAuth flows. Useful for troubleshooting.

MANAGE_PREMIUM_STATUS.title: Manage Premium Status
MANAGE_PREMIUM_STATUS.description: Can view and change player authentication status (Premium/Cracked) from the player detail page.

MANAGE_PREMIUM_LOGIN_SETTINGS.title: Manage Premium Login Settings
MANAGE_PREMIUM_LOGIN_SETTINGS.description: Can configure Microsoft OAuth settings for the Premium Login plugin.

activity-logs.UPDATED_PLAYER_PREMIUM_STATUS: {username} changed the authentication status of player {targetUsername} to {newAccountType}.
activity-logs.UPDATED_PREMIUM_LOGIN_SETTINGS: {username} updated the Premium Login plugin settings.

username-change.subject: Your username has been changed on {websiteName}
username-change.title: Username Change Required
username-change.body: A Minecraft premium account has claimed the username you were using. Your username has been temporarily changed. Please set a new username by clicking the button below.
username-change.new-mc-username: Minecraft username that claimed your name
username-change.expiration-body: This link will expire in 15 minutes. After that, you can log in with your email and password and set a new username.
username-change.alternative: If you didn't expect this change, you can log in with your email and password. You will be prompted to set a new username.
username-change.footer: If you have any questions, please contact our support team.

set-username.title: Set Your Username
set-username.description: A Minecraft premium account has claimed your username. Please choose a new username to continue.
set-username.success: Username updated successfully! You can now log in with your new username.

error.REGISTER_USERNAME_NOT_AVAILABLE: This username is already taken. Please choose another one.
error.REGISTER_USERNAME_TOO_SHORT: Username must be at least 3 characters.
error.REGISTER_USERNAME_TOO_LONG: Username must be at most 16 characters.
error.REGISTER_INVALID_USERNAME: Username can only contain letters, numbers and underscores.
error.INVALID_TOKEN: Invalid or expired link. Please log in with your email to set a new username.
